notes: Man in striped vest and an older man in flat cap appear from the right about 8s in; vest man then roams the room.

Grey-haired woman with white dog is already walking in at the first tile (not in previous strip, so counted here); door leaf propped open in view; man in khaki jacket close to camera blocks much of the last 40s.
Khaki-jacket man and others close to camera cover the door area for most of the strip; man in teal cap emerges from the bottom-left, origin unclear.
Older man in grey cap and tan jacket seems to come in past the door leaf at ~16s, then stands right at the camera blocking the view for ~40s.
Group comes in from ~30s (person with black backpack, woman in navy puffer, young man in dark coat, older man with glasses) and stands at the camera, hiding the door for the last third.
Tall man with hair bun and woman in brown fur-collar coat enter ~18-24s; man in black North Face jacket and a woman walk toward the door and vanish just before, taken as leaving.
Crowd standing in front of the propped door; a woman in black seems to exit ~20s and a curly-haired person comes in at the bottom edge ~38s, both uncertain.
Khaki-jacket man's back and a man in a grey cap at the lens cover the door side most of the minute; no crossing seen.
From ~26s a young man's head right at the lens fills the frame; door side unseen for the rest of the strip.
First 8s blocked by a head at the lens; afterwards people and two dogs mill near the propped door but no clear crossing; a man with a black dog is new to view, entry not seen.
People at the lens block the first ~20s; later a woman with two dogs and a child stand in the doorway area without a clear crossing.

Person in teal sweater and blue beanie enters ~10s; then a group pushes in past the lens ~22-42s (roughly five: denim-jacket man, purple-sweater man, two women, tall man in dark coat), count approximate; grey-cap man walks to the door just before the view is blocked and is counted as leaving (he comes back in from the right at 52290).
Man in red jacket and blue cap pauses at the lens then disappears at the door side ~24s, taken as leaving; vest man with screen backpack then blocks ~20s.
Fur-collar woman and tall man walk out ~6-14s; from ~28s a steady stream enters past the vest man's back (about nine, including grey-cap man and red-jacket man returning); count approximate.
Woman in white puffer and a woman in a dark coat with a cup walk to the door ~18-26s; after that the vest man's back fills most of the frame.
Khaki-jacket man with shoulder bag walks to the door and is gone ~34s; vest man's back, a man with a tablet and a woman's head at the lens block much of the rest.
Heads at the lens block the first ~12s; in the last 20s red-jacket man, a dark-haired woman in black and a blonde woman head to the door and are gone, numbers approximate.
Long-haired man in blue cap with backpack enters ~12s; view blocked by a head ~32-44s; two people in black (one with grey beanie and crossbody bag) come in ~48-54s.
Person in dark hoodie and a woman in olive quilted jacket with blue bag enter in the first 10s; young man in leather jacket then stands at the lens for ~30s.

Quiet and clear for 40s; then a grey-haired man in glasses and navy puffer comes in from the door side and stands at the lens; a woman with a phone is by the door for one tile at ~40s, direction unknown.
Two men at the lens (grey-haired man in puffer, young man in leather jacket) hide the door side for nearly the whole minute.
Leather-jacket man at the lens for the first 20s; the remaining 40s are clear and nobody crosses.
Dark-haired woman in black blazer and light jeans appears by the door ~12s and then drifts back and forth near it; vest man's back covers the left half, right edge mostly visible.
Curly-haired woman in leather jacket with backpack comes in ~8-10s and joins a group that then stands in front of the door for the rest of the minute.
Group stands across the doorway all minute; near the end a person with a blue backpack comes in at the bottom edge and hugs one of them; other crossings would be hidden.
Dense group (leather jacket, blue backpack, others) stands across the doorway all minute; no crossing can be made out.

Around 12-20s the doorway group (woman in navy puffer, man in blue cap with cup, curly-haired woman, grey-haired woman) moves toward the door and is gone afterwards; departures are an estimate; a hooded figure in dark puffer seems to enter ~32s; leather-jacket back blocks the rest.
Leather-jacket man's back fills the frame all minute; a woman in a black face mask appears at the door side ~34s, possibly entering.
Leather-jacket man's back covers the left two-thirds for 40s; the group then disperses (mostly leftward) and an older man in grey cap and navy jacket walks to the door ~48-54s.
Woman in grey coat and red knit hat with a cup enters ~24s, looks at the wall, then walks up to the lens; a couple of heads pass along the bottom edge with unclear direction.
Vest man stands at the lens from ~18s to the end; the strip of doorway visible beside him shows no crossing.
Vest man at the lens for the first 30s; a woman in a cream shearling jacket seems to walk in behind him ~6-8s, and a man in a navy quilted jacket walks toward the door ~30s; both uncertain.

From ~8s a stream of people enters (group of about four women with cups, a couple, a man with backpack, a man in light-blue jacket, older man in navy hoodie); count approximate; two of the men look like ones who walked out a few minutes earlier.

Person in red beanie and navy puffer enters early; a man in a cap with a cup (~34s) and a tall man in a navy jacket (~44s) walk to the door; crowd and a long-haired person at the lens obscure part of the doorway.

Man in black cap with backpack exits ~6s; two women (olive jacket with blue bag, black fur-hood puffer) come in ~8-12s and then stand bent over at the lens for the rest of the minute, hiding much of the door.
